About Inkisle

Inkisle (written InkIsle in the logo, read "ink-ISLE") is a strategy game about islands, fleets and ink. It is made by ipe(), a small studio run by one developer, and it is still in development. There is no store page, no release date and no final price yet.

How it plays

  • Every island produces troops over time. You own some islands, the other side owns some, and neutral islands hold a fixed number.
  • Drag from one of your islands to another island to send a fleet. A bar at the bottom lets you choose how much to send: 25, 50, 75 or 100%.
  • When a fleet arrives with more troops than the island holds, it captures the island and the island fills with your color. Fortresses defend at 1.5 times their number.
  • Stages take about 3 to 5 minutes, are played upright with one hand, and need no network.

What is decided, and what is not

TopicStatus
NameInkisle, decided on 2026-10-29. Trademark checks are not done yet.
PlatformsiOS first is planned, with Android developed alongside. No date.
PriceNot decided. The current plan is: the first seas are free, the rest unlock with a single purchase, no ads, no energy, no loot boxes.
StoryNone, on purpose. The pull is the fun of taking islands and wanting the next sea.
Online playLater, if players want it. The engine is built so that it could be added.

Why a journal

We build in public. The Journal publishes one post a day while the game is made: decisions, prototypes, mistakes and numbers. Posts say plainly what has been measured and what has not.

Who makes it

Inkisle is made by ipe(). See ipe.rest for the studio and its other projects. For questions write to ipe.haven@gmail.com. How this site treats your data is described in the Privacy Policy.
